“Ghosting Busters” Part 7: My first job, a canva ad

Canva technically gave me a job…
It’s to tell you to sign up for free at canva.com and start making stand out resumes with ease.

Canva asked me to make a resume with Canva. Turns out, a two-dimensional resume can still stop people in their tracks… especially when it’s gargantuan.

Good design tools are accessible to everyone, not just people with a subscription.

Shortly after this footage a catastrophic “leg crushing incident” occurred and I was asked to leave immediately.

#CanvaPartner
